alternate_names: 4 Esdras; 4 Esd; Esdras IV; Apocalypse of Ezra; 2 Esdras (Apocrypha)

kjv_title: Tobit
note: Deuterocanonical, and in the Catholic canon. This edition follows the Greek, whose chapter and verse division differs from the Vulgate the Douay-Rheims translates: 244 verses here against the Douay-Rheims's 298. A Vulgate-numbered citation may land on different words.

kjv_title: Judith
note: Deuterocanonical, and in the Catholic canon. This edition follows the Greek, whose chapter and verse division differs from the Vulgate: 339 verses here against the Douay-Rheims's 345.

kjv_title: The Rest of the Chapters of The Book of Esther Which are Found Neither in the Hebrew, nor in the Chaldee
alternate_names: Esther (Greek); Greek Esther; Additions to Esther; Rest of the Chapters of Esther
note: Deuterocanonical, and in the Catholic canon, but printed here as a separate book rather than integrated. It carries the Vulgate's own chapter and verse numbers, 10:4 through 16:24, so a Vulgate citation of Esther 13-16 addresses this book and not the Esther under token Esth.

kjv_title: The Wisdom of Jesus the Son of Sirach, or Ecclesiasticus
note: Deuterocanonical, and in the Catholic canon. TRAP: “Eccli.” is this book, not Ecclesiastes. This edition follows the Greek, whose chapter and verse division differs from the Vulgate, often by one or more verses: 1393 verses here against the Douay-Rheims's 1591.

kjv_title: Baruch
note: Deuterocanonical, and in the Catholic canon. Chapter 6 is the Epistle of Jeremias, as in the Vulgate. 213 verses, the same total as the Douay-Rheims, but not the same division: chapter 3 has 37 verses here against 38 because this edition joins what the Vulgate divides at 3:34, and chapter 6 has 73 against 72. A Vulgate citation of Baruch 3:35-38 is one verse ahead of this edition and 3:38 falls past the end of its chapter, so it refuses.

kjv_title: The Song of The Three Holy Children
modern_name: Song of the Three Holy Children
alternate_names: Prayer of Azariah; Song of the Three Children; Benedicite; Azariah
note: Deuterocanonical, and in the Catholic canon, but printed here as a separate book of 68 verses rather than integrated. The Vulgate and the Douay-Rheims print this matter inside Daniel at 3:24-90. The correspondence is not a uniform offset, so this edition asserts none: a Daniel 3:24-90 citation is withheld rather than resolved here.
